name: Sun Corporation
summary: Sun Corporation engages in the global data intelligence, entertainment, information technology, and other businesses in Japan. the company operates through four segments: Global Data Intelligence Business, Entertainment- Related Business, IT-Related Business, and Wellness Business. It develops, manufactures, and sells mobile data transfer devices and mobile data solutions for law enforcement authorities.
